proposal.summary: Authenticated users could trigger a denial of service in GitLab when importing or cloning malicious content in affected versions (15.11–<16.1.5, 16.2–<16.2.5, 16.3–<16.3.1).
proposal.affected_product: GitLab; versions starting from 15.11 before 16.1.5, starting from 16.2 before 16.2.5, starting from 16.3 before 16.3.1
proposal.cwe_quote: An authenticated user could trigger a denial of service when importing or cloning malicious content.

A.quote: An authenticated user could trigger a denial of service when importing or cloning malicious content.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request or review a proof-of-concept and resource usage measurements (CPU/memory) during an import/clone of the malicious content to confirm impact and reproduction steps; determine whether authentication is required and which user roles are affected.

evidence_quotes.quote: An issue has been discovered in GitLab affecting all versions starting from 15.11 before 16.1.5, all versions starting from 16.2 before 16.2.5, all versions starting from 16.3 before 16.3.1.
An authenticated user could trigger a denial of service when importing or cloning malicious content.
